summary: Patrick Fultz, 29, of Avon died (his dog also died) after his Toyota FJ Cruiser rolled over in Warden Gulch near Peru Creek east of Keystone; he and the dog were ejected; Summit County Rescue Group + Summit County Sheriff's Office + animal control responded ~2:12 p.m. (41 responders); Flight for Life confirmed death, ruled accidental — massive head/internal injuries
location: Warden Gulch near Peru Creek, east of Keystone
notes: Article dated 2015-10-20 says 'died Sunday' -> 2015-10-18 (Sunday-verified via date -d); Vail Daily feed repost via Vail Chamber (Alli Langley); dog death noted in summary, victims=1 human-only convention
